direction.zero_moment: rho^2*h=chi_y, chi compact and flat; exact identity, no numerical cancellation
direction.parameter: f_lambda=f+lambda*h; lambda is fixed and finite independently of epsilon

initial_coverage: [0,5/4]; exact zero on [0,1], then old N1024 whole-cell partition restricted to r<=5/4

partition.target_background: Existing authenticated exact target row r=5/4; no point query

flat_tail_method: Authenticated s^(2k)*exp(4-s), s>=4096/63, k<=3; monotone and flat endpoint zero
background_reuse: Only rho,p,a cell/target fields from authenticated original RAW_BOXES.json, rho_b and Fprime from authenticated shell box, global p_y from ACTUAL_ANNULUS_STATIC_JETS.json; a_y=-rho^-2-p^2/3. Original f,xi and old initial/total-response norms are not bounds for this direction.

bounds.norms: Take componentwise whole-cone maxima, then upward rational Gram square roots D0,Dr,Dv
bounds.source_forcing_difference: exactly zero; no FH,GH,clock,measure or Q1 charge in homogeneous difference
bounds.history_quadrature: Exact positive cell weights times whole-cell s boxes; absolute-history weights use magnitudes

registered_tests: volume kernel history interval excludes zero and Fprime.hi<0
expansion kernel history interval excludes zero and Fprime.hi<0
stopping_rule: If any registered test fails, report that test inconclusive. Do not change direction, normalization, partition, tail method, target, or gates within this experiment. Any new experiment requires a new versioned preregistration.
scope: Conditional on the same retained background/operator/gauge/existence premises; no new independent PDE observation. No broad replay, publication edit, commit, push, or CI.
